title: baqar ke ghar me phaili masarrat ki roushni
body:
baqar ke ghar me phaili masarrat ki roushni
hai do jaha'n me haq o sadaqat ki roushni
<<DIVIDER>>
ha ye imame jaffer e sadiq ka noor hai
jaayegi taa ba arsh sadaqat ki roushni
<<DIVIDER>>
baqar ka laal aaya hai padhte raho durood
phailao chaar soo ye ibadat ki roushni
<<DIVIDER>>
martoob panjetan se hai phailegi hashr tak
sadiq ka noor yaani imamat ki roushni
<<DIVIDER>>
ham manqebat sunate hai baqar ke laal ko
bazme wila me phaili hai jannat ki roushni
<<DIVIDER>>
phailayenge zamane me ham isko har taraf
sadiq ka hai payaam mohabbat ki roushni
<<DIVIDER>>
ham paanchwe imam ko dete hai tehniyat
karlenge wo qubool aqidat ki roushni
<<DIVIDER>>
sajjad ka hai pota ye baqar ka noore ain
baatega ye bhi ilm ki doulat ki roushni
<<DIVIDER>>
pohancha do ham ko shehre madeena mere imaam
aankhou pe sab ki rakh do ziyarat ki roushni
